_comment: Source list for tools/audio/gen_sfx.py. Fields: id (stable), replaces (Sounds constant or file it replaces), event, feel, prompt (English, one sound event), duration (seconds, 0.5-30), variations, priority (1-5, see docs/design/audio-refonte.md), volume_db (relative mix level used at integration), test (true = part of the first 5-sound trial). Status of each sound is tracked in tools/audio/generated.json (written by the tool).
style: Original fantasy action game sound, clean and punchy, warm and crystalline, no reverb tail, no music, no voice, isolated single sound effect.

sounds.event: Ordinary enemy dies (heard hundreds of times)
sounds.prompt: Short soft magical pop of a small monster dissolving into glittering dust, light airy puff with a tiny glassy sparkle, no low bass, no harsh highs, dry, very short

sounds.feel: light, rewarding, quieter than a level-up
sounds.prompt: Tiny bright crystal chime, a single soft glassy ping with a quick warm decay, pleasant, delicate, very short, dry

Magical level-up jingle: a soft magical swell, then a short rising crystal and harp arpeggio of four notes, ending on a warm luminous chord with a gentle shimmering tail, bright but not harsh, uplifting, no drums
Quick sharp katana slash, thin metallic whoosh with a crisp blade edge, fast attack and short decay, no impact, no voice

sounds.feel: heavy and dangerous but readable, cuts through a dense mix
sounds.prompt: Huge monster fist slamming the ground, deep thud with a cracking stone impact and a short rumble, powerful, clear mid frequency punch, short decay, no music

sounds.feel: distinct from XP: metallic, dry, a bit lower
sounds.prompt: Single small gold coin clink, short metallic tick with a warm ring, dry, pleasant

sounds.feel: richer than an ordinary death, still short
sounds.prompt: Monster shattering into magical golden shards, short crunchy burst followed by a bright glassy chime fading quickly, satisfying, controlled
Soft crystal UI button click, tiny wooden tick with a faint glassy tone, very short, dry, gentle
Deep ominous magical horn-like rumble rising, a dark portal tearing open, menacing but clear, short dramatic swell then abrupt end, no music
Monster roar mixed with a surge of crackling dark energy, short and powerful, rising intensity then cut
Massive creature collapsing, deep final groan, then a bright magical burst and glittering shards, satisfying and triumphant, controlled tail

sounds.event: Boss blade attacks (cross slash, iaido, blade rain)
sounds.prompt: Heavy sword slash whoosh with a ringing metallic edge, fast and dangerous, sharp attack, short decay

sounds.event: Boss fire attacks (breath, beam, rings, meteors)
sounds.prompt: Roaring burst of fire, whooshing flames igniting with a low rumble, intense but short, no screaming
Sharp ice crystals erupting from the ground, glassy crack and a cold shimmering burst, short and crisp
Wet toxic spit splash with bubbling acid, slimy burst then a short fizz, unpleasant but short
Magical energy projectiles launching in a quick burst, bright zaps with a whoosh, short

sounds.event: Boss wind attacks (wing blast, flyby, storm)
sounds.prompt: Powerful gust of wind from huge wings, whooshing air with a low rumble, short, no voice
Dark magical summoning, ritual chime with a low swelling hum and clinking chains, short, ominous
Quick arrow release, light bowstring twang and short airy whistle, very short
Small magical bolt cast, soft energy zap with a light shimmer, very short
Small toxic spit, short wet squirt with a tiny bubble, very short
Large monster collapsing with a deep thud then a bright magical shatter and chime, richer than a normal death, short
Small fire burst impact, soft whoomp with crackling embers, short and punchy
Crisp ice crystal impact, glassy crack with a cold sparkle, short
Quick electric zap crack, sharp spark with a bright snap, very short
Compact magical explosion, punchy mid-range boom with a short sparkle, controlled, no long tail
Large explosion, deep boom with debris crackle and a short rumble, powerful but clean, short tail
Warm magical reward chime, three rising soft bell notes with a shimmering finish, pleasant

sounds.event: Unlock card appears on end screen
sounds.prompt: Short soft magical whoosh with a tiny crystal sparkle, gentle

sounds.feel: triumphant, warm, magical, clearly a win
sounds.prompt: Triumphant victory fanfare jingle: warm bright brass-like horns and shimmering harp glissando rising to a majestic resolving major chord with a gentle sparkling tail, heroic, joyful, uplifting, no drums, no voice

sounds.feel: satisfying relief and accomplishment, below a level-up
sounds.prompt: Satisfying wave-completed sound: a soft deep magical whoosh releasing tension, then two warm rising marimba and crystal bell notes resolving into a bright harmonious chord with a short shimmering tail, rewarding, uplifting, not epic, no drums, no voice
